input.expected_problem: Bot may get confused by caller who changes their mind mid-conversation

conversation.content: Hello, this is Monica at Demo Clinic Alpha. How can I help you?
Hi, I think I need to schedule an appointment.
Sure! What would the appointment be for?
Actually, wait. Before I do that - do you know if my lab results are back? I had blood work last week.
I can help you check on that. Were you feeling anxious about the results?
Hmm, actually never mind the labs. Let me just schedule the appointment. But wait - what are your hours? I need to figure out when I can come in.
Our office hours are Monday through Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM, and Saturday from 9 AM to 1 PM. We're closed on Sundays. Is there anything else I can help with?
Okay, so you're open until 5. That might work. Actually, can I check on those lab results first after all? Then I'll know if I even need to come in.
Got it! I can help you check on that. You mentioned it was blood work last week, right? Were you feeling anxious about the results?
Okay. Actually, I changed my mind, I do want to schedule either way. Sorry, I know I'm all over the place today.
No problem at all! What would the appointment be for?
Sorry, I'm just stressed. Let me focus. I need to: one, check my lab results, and two, schedule a follow-up regardless of the results. Can we do both?
I've routed your request to check on your lab results. While you wait for that, we can go ahead and schedule your follow-up appointment. What date and time would work best for you?
Thank you for bearing with me. I know I was confusing. For the appointment, how about next Tuesday at 10 AM?
I can help with that! Before we proceed, could I have your full name and date of birth to verify your identity?
Sure! My name is Michelle Lee, and my date of birth is April 22, 1988.
I have Tuesday, December 23 at 9:00 AM or Friday, December 26 at 2:00 PM. Which works for you?
Oh, I’m sorry, I meant to say next week, not the week after. Can we do next Tuesday, the 19th, at 10 AM instead?
I can help with that! However, the available slots are Tuesday, December 23 at 9:00 AM or Friday, December 26 at 2:00 PM. Which one works for you?
Got it! Let's go with Tuesday, December 23 at 9:00 AM then. Thank you!
Perfect! Now I just need a few details to complete your booking. Great! I still need your phone number. Can you provide that for me?
Sure! My phone number is 555-666-7777.
Thank you! And could you please provide your email address?
Of course! My email address is mlee@email.com.
Thank you! Let me confirm all the details. Michelle, you're booked for December 23, 2025, at 09:00. Confirmation email will be sent to mlee@email.com. Anything else?
No, that sounds great! Just to confirm, could you please check on my lab results? I'd like to know if they're back before my appointment.
I've already routed your request to check on your lab results. You should receive an update shortly. Would you like me to send you a text? You can reply anytime if questions come up.
Yes, that would be helpful! Please send me a text. Thank you for all your help today!
I'll send you a text right now. You can reply anytime with questions!
